sources.label: Wikipedia, "55 Cancri Ab"
sources.quote: 55 Cancri Ab, formally named Galileo, is an exoplanet orbiting the Sun-like star 55 Cancri A every 14.65 days.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around 55 Cnc; its size is a model. Its tilt is not measured: it is drawn in the plane measured for 55 Cnc d.

sources.quote: It is the second planet in order of distance from its star, and is an example of a hot Jupiter, or possibly rather "warm Jupiter".
